Plane7 Nov, after your approval: B-2..B-5 filed as NDC-2811..NDC-2814 (state Bug, module Desk, Sprint 15, image attached, related to NDC-2275 and NDC-1978). Comments on NDC-2275 / NDC-2752 / NDC-1978 drafted, not posted

Summary

Most of the feature works as specified. On 7 Nov a new build fixed B-1 (round robin on Ticket Create): E-08, D-07, F-10 and H-12 now pass. 4 open bugs: B-2 and B-3 (re-checked 7 Nov, still there), B-4, new on 7 Nov (the New Ticket form shows an owner it does not save; it looks like a side effect of the B-1 fix), and B-5, new on 7 Nov (holiday criteria ignore a holiday list that is not linked to business hours). The audit-log conversion report (J-03) was found and passes. E-05, F-14, G-06 and J-04 were run later on 7 Nov: E-05, F-14 and G-06 pass, J-04 passes in part (owners kept; no old history entries name a rule, so that half cannot be checked). The remaining open cases and the three E2E journeys were run on 7 Nov and pass. Cases still not run are listed in each group with the reason.

Bugs

IdSeverityBugCasesStatus
B-1High Fixed 7 NovRound robin never runs on Ticket Create. Retest 7 Nov: owner is no longer set to the creator; RR assigns on create (tickets "QA AS6 SEQ B1 create no owner" → A3, "… owner null" → A1); with all agents offline the ticket waits unassigned (backlog). Original text: A ticket created by API (owner omitted or owner: null) or the New Ticket form always gets the creator as owner, so the round-robin rule sees an owned ticket and does nothing. Direct rules on create do work. Same as the 5 Nov retest.E-08, D-07, F-10, H-12 — all PASS 7 NovNDC-2275 (state Bug) — can be retested
B-2HighRound robin ignores the Email channel. An agent who is signed in but has the Email channel off (online: true, channels.email: false) still gets tickets and is not marked SKIPPED; with all three agents on Email off the ticket is still assigned. Zoho assigns only to agents online in the mail channel. A full sign-out is skipped correctly. Re-checked 7 Nov with A2 online (heartbeat, Chat + Phone on, Email off): A2 still got its turn, no SKIPPED; all three Email off → ticket still assigned to A1. Image (approved): screenshots/annotated/B2-email-channel-off-vs-zoho.pngRR-10, E-12, E-16Filed NDC-2811 (7 Nov)
B-3MediumTeam Assignment off does not stop manual team assignment. With Dept A Team Assignment off, POST /desk/tickets/{id}/assign {team_id} returns 200 and the ticket gets the team (7 Nov: ticket #1189 shows Owner "QA AS6 Team A"). New rules with a team target are refused correctly (team_assignment_off). The ticket screen is correct: with Team Assignment off its owner picker shows only AGENTS, with it on AGENTS + TEAMS. TAVI's own help text says "Off: only agents can be chosen." So the gap is the API only. Image: screenshots/annotated/B3-team-assignment-off-api-vs-zoho.pngF-12Filed NDC-2812 (7 Nov)
B-4MediumNew Ticket form shows an owner it does not save. The form opens with Ticket Owner = the signed-in user (ndc-staging-owner). Saving without touching it sends no owner (the POST has no owner field) and the ticket is saved Unassigned (#1200, Dept B, no rules). In a department with a round-robin create rule the ticket then goes to the next agent (#1199 → Dev Team 2) although the form showed ndc-staging-owner. Zoho (7 Nov, seen): the Add Ticket form also pre-fills Ticket Owner with the signed-in agent; Zoho was not submitted, so what it saves was not seen. Image: screenshots/annotated/B4-new-ticket-owner-not-saved-vs-zoho.pngD-14Filed NDC-2813 (7 Nov)
B-5Medium"On a holiday" ignores a holiday list that is not linked to business hours. Holiday lists can be saved without business hours (Setup → Holidays, business hours switch off = "detached"), and the rule criteria picker offers them. Rule "QA AS6 B08 holiday" with list "QA AS6 HOL today" (one holiday: 7 Nov 2026): on 7 Nov, on a holiday of did not match (#1229 stayed unassigned) and not a holiday of did match (#1230 → A2), so today is treated as a working day. After linking the same list to a business-hours profile ("QA AS6 BH", not the default), the same rule worked: #1233 → A1, #1234 unassigned. A detached list with 25 Dec behaves correctly (#1231 no match, #1232 → A3). The criterion is "on a holiday of a list" (GEN-5c), so either the list should count without business hours, or the picker should not offer detached lists. Re-run for the image: list detached again → #1252 Unassigned, #1254 → A2. Zoho (seen): a holiday list can also be saved with Business Hours off; Zoho runtime with such a list not checked. Image: screenshots/annotated/B5-holiday-list-not-attached-vs-zoho.pngB-08Filed NDC-2814 (7 Nov)

Minor / info (not bugs yet)

  • I-1 A Desk Agent without "Manage assignment rules" can still read Round Robin Preferences (GET …/round-robin-preferences 200); everything else is 403.
  • I-2 API accepts "Agent level threshold" on with no agent rows; the UI blocks it ("Pick an agent.").
  • I-3 Deleting a skill type that skills still use now returns 409 (on 1 Nov it left the skills untyped). Zoho behaviour not checked.
  • I-4 The Assignment Rules page took 35 s to show its content (settings pages were 10–25 s before).
  • I-5 A ticket that becomes a backlog ticket gets no history entry (only the later assignment is logged).
  • I-6 Execute skill-based assignment for one ticket not found — 7 Nov: ticket ⋯ menu has Recalculate Skills and Assign by Skills (POST /desk/tickets/{id}/skills/assign); H-09 PASS.
  • I-9 (7 Nov) Assign by Skills on a ticket that already has an owner reassigns it (A1 → A2) with no warning. Zoho behaviour not checked.
  • I-7 "Assign backlogs" ran about once a minute (first backlog ticket assigned after 77 s, the next 61 s later).
  • I-8 Criteria fields: 17 contact fields (Zoho 26). 7 Nov: Created Time, Modified Time and Closed Time are now in the list (created_time, modified_time, closed_time); Is Escalated still not found.
  • I-10 Holiday operators not runnable — 7 Nov: NDC-Staging had no holiday list, so I created two QA lists and one QA business-hours profile (ledger) and ran it: see B-08 and B-5.
  • I-12 (7 Nov) The agent threshold counts the agent's open + On Hold tickets in every department, not only the department of the round-robin rule (A1: Dept A 60 + Dept B 6 → 66 counted). TAVI's help text says "Maximum number of open tickets an agent in the department can handle". Zoho behaviour not checked. Decide whether this is wanted.
  • I-11 (7 Nov) Conversion report readability: in the Audit Log each converted rule shows as "updated X's ID from f2d1… to f2d1…" and "type from round_robin to round_robin", which reads as if nothing changed, and the old method / agents are not shown. The precedence change shows raw rule ids ("runs before round robin rules from blank value to 2f18…,6f38…,ecab…"). The "Assignment conversion report" actor is not in the Audit Log users filter list (facets API), so it cannot be filtered on.
